plan.model: existing pinned local MiniLM; same blend, depth, four-note cap, 2000 code characters
plan.candidate: For a linked note with a direct recorded call, score exact caller and callee declarations from current authorized snapshot, 1000 chars each (prefix and suffix when longer). Prefer pairs naming the query identifier, then deterministic edge order. Fall back to unchanged original source window if no usable pair. No candidate addition or filtering.
plan.acceptance: Strict pooled precision improvement, no per-query recall loss, all callee-rationale and four-formatting-note IDs retained. All 48 existing synthetic queries are regression, not new holdouts. No retuning after results.
plan.full_repository: Run same 11 frozen questions at all three exact historical Nexus commits, default source policy and same retrieval/token options. Audit indexed documents and every delivered source excerpt. Full-repository scope includes only policy-eligible sources; exclusions recorded. Compare to the prior 1-3-file slices.

scoring_correction.description: Location tasks accept a hash-bound exact definition citation in evidence.code_graph as well as route.symbols. A clipped source body cannot satisfy behavior or rationale. Frozen queries and source-span labels unchanged. Original packets and original driver results retained.

profile.scope: Only sync/context tested; review/history differences are not exercised. Slice and full corpus both use this executable.
profile.debug_run: Interrupted during first graph construction before any scored queries. Partial index excluded from results.

full_repository_comparison.model_calls: Local MiniLM only; no remote model calls
full_repository_comparison.interpretation: Required-span delivery, not generated-answer correctness; no full-repository reviewed-note labels. Source policy exclusions retained. No latency comparison because local work overlapped.

decision: Keep current product scorer. Pair context preserved recall but did not improve precision. Full-repository retrieval reveals missing named-symbol bodies; test source selection and whole-declaration packing next.
limitations: Only two captured diagnostic queries and nine authored real-code queries; no independent human-query traffic.

Full corpus means policy-eligible repository sources: credential paths/symlinks excluded before reads, and normal size/binary/conversion exclusions retained. All gold source files match their frozen hashes.
Reviewed-note quality is synthetic; the full-repository snapshots contain no reviewed-note corpus.
Required-span delivery is not end-to-end agent or generated-answer accuracy.

The release executable differs from current source only in review/history implementation and associated integration tests; sync/context sources match. The same release binary ran both slice and full controls.
One debug setup was interrupted before queries; it is excluded. Functional runs overlap and are not controlled latency measurements.
Scoring was corrected to accept verified exact symbol citations for location questions only. Original raw packets/results and hash-verified launch code are preserved.
Pair snippets are bounded prefixes/tails for long declarations; they are scorer inputs, not a proof of complete branch delivery.
